adoption: Requested/returned fields alone do not establish correct use. Preserve evidence pointers and uncertainty without imposing a new answer citation format.
cost_accounting: all actual attempts, mixed calls, retries/refusals/fallback and native work remain fully charged
counting_rule: Count one same-class supplement attempt after a relevant relation response when an actual native/tool attempt supplies in-selection local vertices/connectivity/shape information through a new scene read, cache print, or cache computation of geometry not previously model-visible. A mixed attempt counts once and stays fully charged. Pure computation from already model-visible complete inputs is recorded as compute-only and excluded from this count. Newly required triangles still count as legitimate supplementary geometry, with no already-delivered redundancy tag. Repeated centers/simple arithmetic and relation recomputation remain their separate classes. Failed/refused attempts keep their attempted functional class and outcome.
field_coverage_rules: A schema capability or available selected object is not a delivered field.
Boundary local_evidence vertices are not the full evaluated vertex/connectivity arrays.
Vertices-only geometry does not deliver triangles.
An unknown observation is not a valid replacement for a missing field.
Actual ID/name aliases require the same scene-bound identity and generation.
Earlier full geometry in a native response can make later geometry redundant.
A complete persistent array created by prior consumer code can avoid new acquisition even when not printed. Record program-state availability separately from model-visible delivery.
Coordinator-only INITIAL snapshots do not automatically count as delivered consumer data. Use actual exposed responses/code and mark uncertainty.
Computation from delivered coordinates is computation, not a new scene read.
A legitimate new reference or field remains new information in a mixed call. Its whole duration/tokens still count.
mechanism_success: At least 2/3 G cells naturally use geometry correctly and avoid the historical same-class local supplement, and G total same-class local supplements are below current-round P. Respect any P route that already avoids supplementation.
modifiers: new_non_geometry_fields such as actually missing material/color
per_attempt_fields: actual object identities and field set
previous relevant relation bindings and source/generation
per_cell_fields: geometry_correctly_used and externally checkable answer/code pointers
total tool attempts and actual RPC

primary_classes.already_returned_subtag: Set only for the exact same object instance, source generation and field actually delivered earlier.
primary_classes.definition: Local geometry or shape information for the actual relevant target/candidate bindings; vertices/connectivity and locally derived shape facts.
Information about another reference object outside that relation selection; record the actual new fields and whether they were already known.
Re-reading a delivered center/AABB or redoing simple arithmetic from already delivered coordinates. Exact surface/solid solving belongs to relation_recomputation.
Recomputing closed-solid class, surface gap, witness or relation evidence. Preserve whether an earlier result was measured, unknown or absent.

prior_coverage_mechanism_credit: If relevant full geometry was already model-visible, a later geometry attachment adds no such fields and absence of a last native call alone does not establish replacement. Prior consumer-program cache availability and novel model-visible delivery remain separate, allowing a delivery-roundtrip observation without claiming new acquisition savings.
roundtrip_claim: Only reduced actual total tool calls supports fewer model-tool round trips. Reduced fields in a mixed call is partial coverage.
uncertainty_rule: Uncertain operation, source binding or correct use stays unknown. Unknown is not zero supplements and is not one of the required 2/3 adopted cells. If uncertainty can change G
unit: actual native/tool attempt with per-field tags; mixed attempts remain one fully charged attempt
